calibration_method: Isotonic regression on out-of-fold predictions, refit on full data
limitations: Metrics are out-of-fold on the training distribution described by training_source — they are not an independent hold-out. Region skill is published two ways: per-region (per_region) and by rotating region hold-out (holdout_region), which trains on three regions and evaluates the fourth. No EU validation exists; see eu_holdout for why, and do not quote these numbers as European skill. The scorecard refreshes with every nightly seed run.

eu_holdout.reason: Tick Tick Bloom labels cover four U.S. regions only, so no EU-lake hold-out can be computed. Unlocked by citizen Ground Truth Loop labels in the identical row format — region IDs already flow end-to-end, so no code change is needed, only data.

holdout_region.reason: The committed artifacts predate region hold-out rotation; re-export from the training notebook to publish it.

weather_only.note: Weather + static features only; spectral and citizen blocks are zeroed. Usable where no satellite pixels exist — a real number, and a modest one.
